lines.text: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet in dots for US ChatGPT Pro users, with a check on every purchase
Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max, a 2.4T-parameter MoE with 71B active and a 1M-token context
Treasury Secretary Bessent calls for a dramatic NVIDIA shake-up and an outside CEO

feed.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet in dots for US ChatGPT Pro users
feed.why: US Pro users 18 and older with eligible US-issued cards. Each purchase needs a Face ID or fingerprint check. A payment token stands in for the card details.

feed.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max, a 2.4T-parameter MoE with 71B active and a 1M-token context
feed.why: Alibaba says 2.4 trillion total parameters, 71 billion active, native vision, and a 1 million-token context. It is on QwenCloud's API. Lab charts are claims.

feed.headline: Treasury Secretary Bessent calls for a dramatic NVIDIA shake-up and an outside CEO
feed.why: On Fox News Sunday he said the board should look outside the company. He also asked for answers in the next 10 days from the board and outside counsel.

feed.headline: NVIDIA board says it has not formally engaged CEO candidates and is still picking a search firm
feed.why: The board told CNBC it is still selecting a search firm and has not formally engaged any candidates. It called speculation about individual names premature.

feed.headline: OpenAI starts a science blog; first post is a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model
feed.why: Physicist Nathaniel Craig says GPT-6 Astra helped turn his strategy into a construction and proof. He still calls it a candidate that needs further checks.

feed.headline: Anthropic IPO demand is reported near 7 times the shares on offer; range stays $70 to $78
feed.why: Bloomberg reported Sunday that orders were close to seven times the shares on offer. The official range is unchanged. Pricing is still expected 18 Nov.
feed.source: Bloomberg via The Next Web / Anthropic
